Hello A warm welcome to St Nicolas' Church of England Infant School
St Nicolas' Church of England Infant School Homepage
Children are a gift from the Lord; they are a reward from Him (Psalm 127:3-5)
Welcome to our website which, we hope gives you a flavour of our school, its vision, values and work. It is intended to be an active resource for our school community and to provide useful information for prospective parents and staff.
We are well-known for our close community, village-like feel, peaceful setting and quality education. It is an inclusive, welcoming and happy place in which to work and learn and our strongest resource is the effectiveness of the relationships between the adults who work here and our children.
We welcome visitors so please feel free to contact the school office to arrange a convenient time to see us in action and to appreciate first-hand the distinctive atmosphere, qualities and organisation of our unique school.
